profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | C# · .NET Core · Azure · APIs · Microservices | Fintech & Enterprise
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, cloud-native applications in the .NET ecosystem. My core stack is C#, ASP.NET Core, and Azure, and I specialize in designing RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and distributed systems that prioritize performance, reliability, and maintainability.

At U.S. Bank, I've worked across system modernization, API development at scale, and performance optimization within the mortgage post-closing space — giving me a strong understanding of both the technical and business sides of fintech.

Technologies I work with daily: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, Azure (App Services, Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, AKS), SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Redis, Docker, and Azure DevOps.

I'm a believer in clean code, test-driven development, and building things that are technically sound and actually impactful. If you're hiring for a senior .NET / Azure engineering role, I'd love to connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the API and web application for the Final Documentation System (FDS), an internal platform supporting mortgage post-closing by surfacing OCR-extracted checklist data for CDQC loan revive.

• Modernized the FDS web application and rebuilt the API into a more robust, scalable service — achievng 68% faster checklist retrieval per user across 300+ daily API hits.

• Maintained 80% code coverage through test-driven development, ensuring reliability across iterative releases.

• Contributed to system architecture and design decisions, driving technical direction for the platform's continued evolution.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Core · Entity Framework (EF) Core · ASP.NET Web API · Docker · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft Azure · Functional Specifications · C# · .NET Core · Microsoft SQL Server · Azure DevOps Services

positions.description: Led the migration of an internal application from AP.NET Framework to ASP.NET Core 3.1, improving perfomance and reducing long-term maintenance overhead. Mdernized the frontend using Bootstrap 5.1 and deliveed new feature enhancements alongside the platform ugrade.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework (EF) Core · ASP.NET MVC · Functional Specifications · .NET Core
